name: build_game
description: Plan, build and test a complete small game from a one-line idea.

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: What the game is, e.g. 'a coin-collecting platformer'

template:
Build this game in the open Realot editor: {idea}

1. Read the engine guide (get_engine_guide) and the matching recipes (get_recipe, search_docs).
2. Take a restore point with snapshot_project.
3. Look at what exists (get_editor_state, list_entities, list_assets).
4. Build the scene with batch calls (create_entity with components, write_script + attach_script). Run validate_script on every script.
5. check_project, then play_restart and test every mechanic with play_input + assert. Look at play_screenshot.
6. Fix everything you find, re-test, then save_project. Finish with a short summary of what was built and what the controls are.

name: debug_game
description: Find and fix why something in the game is broken.
template:
Debug this problem in the open Realot game: {problem}

1. get_console and check_project for errors; validate_script on the scripts involved.
2. Reproduce it: play_restart, then play_input to do what the player does; use play_get_state / play_get_entity / play_eval to inspect live values and play_screenshot to see it.
3. Form a hypothesis, take snapshot_project, fix it with the smallest change, then re-run the exact same reproduction and confirm the fix with an assert.
4. Report the root cause and what you changed.

name: review_project
description: Audit the project for problems and polish opportunities without changing anything.
template: Audit the open Realot project read-only: check_project, validate_script (all scripts), get_hierarchy, list_scenes, list_assets, get_performance. Play-test the main loop with play_input. Report problems by severity (broken, risky, polish) with the exact entity/script and a suggested fix for each. Do not change anything.

name: add_feature
description: Add one feature to the existing game safely.
template:
Add this feature to the existing Realot game: {feature}

First understand the current project (get_editor_state, find_entities, get_script / search_scripts for related code, search_docs for the engine API). Take snapshot_project. Prefer built-in components over custom code. Implement it with as few batch calls as possible, validate_script, then play-test it and a regression pass over the existing mechanics. Roll back with restore_snapshot if it goes badly.
